title: Cover Letter Generator for College Students: How to Pitch Projects & Land Internships
description: How college students can write compelling, project-centric cover letters for top tech internships without prior full-time experience.
body:
When applying for competitive tech internships at companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, or high-growth YC startups, students often struggle with what to write in a cover letter when they have zero previous corporate experience. The key is shifting focus from *where you have worked* to *what you have built*.

## 1. The 3-Step Student Pitch Strategy

- Step 1: Demonstrate Immediate Product Context. Show you've actually tried their product or read their engineering blog.
- Step 2: Highlight Your Best Technical Project. Describe the architecture, the hardest bug you solved, and what you learned.
- Step 3: Showcase Rapid Learning Velocity. Mention hackathon projects, open-source pull requests, or self-directed coursework.

faq.q: Can I use the same cover letter for multiple internship applications?
faq.a: Never send an identical cover letter. Tailor at least the first and second paragraphs to reference the specific company's product and tech stack.
